title: MalariaCometChip for high-throughput quantification of DNA damage in Plasmodium falciparum
protocol: Maintain synchronized ring stage culture until the majority of parasites reaches mid- to late-schizont stage (roughly after 24 h for P. falciparum 3D7).
Transfer parasite culture from the flask to a 50 mL tube.
Spin down at 1000 RCF, 3 min, brake set to 2 and remove supernatant.
Resuspend 1 ml pellet into 4 ml iRPMI.
Add 10 ml Percoll solution into a 15 ml tube.
Gently lay the parasite suspension onto the Percoll solution by slowly dripping the parasite suspension along the tube wall using a sterile dropper.
Centrifuge at 1000 RCF, 11 min, brake 0.
Collect schizont stage parasites concentrated at the interface of the iRPMI and Percoll solutions.
Add 20 mL of iRPMI to the schizont pellet.
Resuspend and spin down at 1000 RCF for 3 minutes with brake set to 2.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat the previous step once.
Inoculate purified late schizont stage parasites into fresh blood to obtain a final parasitemia of around 3%.
Culture for 18 hours and synchronize using 5% D-sorbitol.
Check blood smear to ensure parasitemia is near or exceeds 10%.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL iRPMI and transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.
Spin down at 1000 RCF for 3 minutes with brake set to 2.
Remove the supernatant.
Measure the volume of the pellet using a pipette.
Enrich live ring stage parasites using SLO.
Calculate the volume of activated SLO needed based on the volume of the pellet.
Activate SLO with 1 M DTT by adding 1 μL of 1M DTT for every 10 uL of SLO, mix gently.
Incubate the activated SLO mixture at room temperature for 15 min.
Add 4 HUs of activated SLO to parasite pellet and gently mix.
Incubate for 6 min at room temperature, inverting tubes ten times every 2 min during incubation.
Spin down the mixture at 1000 RCF for 3 min and remove supernatant.
Add 500 μL of 1× PBS to the pellet and mix thoroughly.
Spin down at 1000 RCF for 3 min and remove supernatant.
Repeat steps vii-viii until the supernatant becomes colorless.
Dilute hydrogen peroxide in cold 1× PBS to the following doses: 100, 250, 500, and 1000 μM.
Load each dose of hydrogen peroxide into 3 macrowells to create technical replicates.
Resuspend 30 μL concentrated parasite pellet in 6 mL cRPMI to achieve a 0.5% hematocrit.
Add 200 μL of the parasite suspension into each well of the bottomless 96-well plate clamped to the CometChip gel.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C incubator supplemented with 5% CO2, 3% O2, and 92% N2 for 15 minutes to load cells into microwells by gravity.
Retrieve low melting point agarose gel from storage.
Allow solution to cool to approximately 43°C.
Unclamp binder clips and gently remove the 96-well plate.
Place the chip at a roughly 30 degree angle.
Gently pipette 5 mL of 1× PBS above the top row to wash away off-grid cells via shear force.
Slowly expel PBS from the pipette in drops to avoid washing away cells loaded in microwells.
Check cell loading under a bright field microscope.
Cool the gel solution to approximately 43°C before proceeding.
Overlay the CometChip with 4 mL of 1% w/v low melting point agarose by gently dripping the melted agarose onto the chip.
Keep the CometChip at 4°C for 4 min to allow agarose to solidify.
Cover the CometChip completely with the low melting point agarose ensuring even coverage.
Apply a bottomless 96-well plate to the same position as in CometChip Fabrication Step 3m, lining up edges precisely.
Use 1.5" binder clips to clamp the bottomless 96-well plate into place on a glass plate.
Add 100 μL of different concentrations of hydrogen peroxide to appropriate wells and incubate chip at 4°C for 20 min in the dark.
Remove the bottomless 96-well plate immediately after incubation.
Dissolve artesunate in 7.5% sodium bicarbonate solution to final concentration of 50 mM (i.e., 19.2 mg in 1 mL 7.5% sodium bicarbonate solution).
Store the artesunate stock in 100 μL aliquots at −20°C for up to 6 months.
Label five 1.5 mL reaction tubes and add the amount of 7.5% sodium bicarbonate solution as required.
Resuspend 30 μL of concentrated parasite pellet in 6 mL cRPMI to achieve 0.5% hematocrit.
Add 20 μL of 10× artesunate solution (or negative control solution) and 180 μL cell suspension to each well of a 96-well plate.
Mix gently and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Directly before use, add Triton X-100 to alkaline lysis stock solution at 1% v/v (i.e., 1 ml Triton X-100 per 100 ml alkaline lysis stock solution).
Submerge the CometChip in a small dish containing working alkaline lysis buffer.
Submerge the CometChip in roughly 100 mL cold alkaline lysis buffer.
Ensure the chip is fully submerged in the buffer.
Check the CometChip after 5 minutes of incubation.
If the chip floats to the top, push it back down using forceps.
Alternatively, affix the chip to the bottom of the pipette tip box lid with double-sided tape before covering in lysis buffer.
Keep the CometChip at 4°C overnight (usually more than 12 hours).
Remove the CometChip from the lysis buffer after incubation.
Gently dry the bottom of the GelBond® film using Kim wipes.
Affix double-sided tape to the electrophoresis chamber.
Transfer the CometChip to the electrophoresis chamber.
Use forceps to gently press the CometChip gel onto the double-sided tape.
Add cold electrophoresis buffer to cover the gel with approximately 5 mm of buffer above the gel.
Incubate at 4°C for 40 minutes to unwind the DNA.
Electrophorese at 1 V/cm and ∼300 mA in the same buffer at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Transfer the CometChip to neutralization buffer immediately after electrophoresis.
Gently shake the CometChip in the neutralization buffer at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Wash the CometChip a second time in neutralization buffer.
Pour out the neutralization buffer.
Submerge the CometChip in 100 mL fresh neutralization buffer.
Gently shake at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Submerge the chip in roughly 50 mL 1× SYBR Gold solution in 1× PBS in the dark using a small dish.
Perform fluorescence microscopy at 40× magnification with a 480-nm excitation filter.
